facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Rage rework: Rage from your hits is normalized to weapon speed, so weapon damage no longer matters, and basic-attack crits give bonus Rage (100% since 1 Oct). Rage from damage taken now ignores armor and absorbs.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: New baseline abilities: Tactical Mastery (level 14) keeps 10 Rage on stance swaps, and Victory Rush (level 20) is an instant strike, usable for 20 seconds after you kill a non-trivial enemy, that heals 10% of your maximum health.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Recklessness, Retaliation and Shield Wall no longer share a cooldown, and Retaliation and Shield Wall are now 15-minute cooldowns.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Battle Shout's base Attack Power is lower, but the old Improved Battle Shout bonus is built in, and since 16 Oct the shout covers the whole raid.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Threat tools: Thunder Clap scales with Attack Power, works in Defensive Stance and has a 6-second cooldown. Sunder Armor threat scales with Attack Power, and Demoralizing Shout threatens every target it hits (8 Oct).

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Arms combines the old weapon specializations into Weaponmaster. The November notes make Improved Tactical Mastery three points and Bloodthrill two points, and shorten Slam to a 15-second base cooldown.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Fury now has Reckless Swings and Improved Whirlwind. Death Wish leads to Bloodthirst. Flurry has three ranks and no longer needs Death Wish.

facts.label: Talent data
facts.value: Protection: Toughness, Improved Shield Block and Improved Taunt are no longer in the tree. Master of Defense, Vanguard and Focused Rage are new, Improved Shield Bash moved, and every other Protection talent is marked changed.

facts.label: Defensive Stance quest (Level 10)
facts.value: A race-specific quest unlocks Defensive Stance, and Taunt and Sunder Armor are trained after it. The Human version is the Bartleby quest, which rewards Bartleby's Mug.

facts.label: Race armor quests (Level 20)
facts.value: Forever leveling guides list race-specific armor quests at this level, for the Fire Hardened Hauberk or the Brutal Hauberk.

facts.label: The Affray (Berserker Stance) (Level 30)
facts.value: Grants Berserker Stance (Warcraft Tavern says Intercept too) and leads into the Whirlwind Weapon quest chain.

facts.label: Main-hand hit from talents
facts.value: None. Furious Precision (Fury) is the only Warrior talent that adds hit, and it covers off-hand attacks only.
facts.note: Hit therefore comes from gear or the Dwarf racial.

facts.label: Hit cap at level 60
facts.note: Blizzard has published no cap, and community estimates conflict.

facts.label: Dwarf and Human racials
facts.value: Dwarf Artisan's Precision: +1% hit with spells and attacks. Human Ruthless: +1% crit (cut from 2% on 26 Oct).

facts.label: Weaponmaster at 5/5
facts.value: +5% crit with axes and polearms, 15% of armor ignored with maces and staves, or a 5% chance of an extra attack with swords.
facts.note: Since 16 Oct, Shield Bash and Shield Slam no longer trigger the sword effect.

facts.label: Bloodthrill
facts.value: Main-hand attacks against your Rend target have a 10% or 20% chance to make Overpower available.

facts.label: Slam
facts.value: The base cooldown is 15 seconds. Improved Slam cuts it by 2.5 or 5 seconds, shortens the cast and global cooldown, and avoids delaying auto-attacks. The October notes made Slam ignore spell pushback.

facts.label: Raid role
facts.value: Warcraft Tavern presents Arms as a battleground spec that is still viable in PvE, and names Fury as the PvE spec.

facts.label: Armor reduction
facts.value: Sunder Armor can be applied even when a stronger Expose Armor is up, so Warriors and Rogues can both contribute.

facts.label: Battle Shout
facts.value: Raid-wide since 16 Oct. Base Attack Power is lower, but the old Improved Battle Shout bonus is built in.

facts.label: Recklessness (talentsforever data)
facts.value: +100% crit chance for 15 seconds while you take 20% more damage. It no longer shares a cooldown with Retaliation or Shield Wall.

facts.label: Onyxia's Lair entry
facts.value: Every raider must carry their own Drakefire Amulet in their bags, and Blizzard tells raids to build fire resistance before the fight.

facts.label: Launch raids
facts.value: Raid unlock date: 9 December 2026, for Barrow Deeps (10 players), Hyjal Summit (20) and Onyxia's Lair (40), all planned to reset weekly.

facts.label: World buffs in raids
facts.value: Icy Veins' raid overview says world buffs are removed inside raids, and Wowhead's Forever data marks Rallying Cry of the Dragonslayer 'No effect while in a raid instance'. Plan raid nights without them.

facts.label: Classic melee consumables
facts.value: Elixir of the Mongoose, Elixir of the Giants, Juju Power, Juju Might, Winterfall Firewater, R.O.I.D.S. and Elemental Sharpening Stone, plus Smoked Desert Dumplings.

facts.label: Flask rule
facts.value: One flask at a time, and it persists through death. Flask of the Titans gives +1200 maximum health for 2 hours.

facts.label: Elixir of the Grizzly
facts.value: New in Forever: +25 Strength and +2% crit for 30 minutes, from a new Alchemy recipe (skill 300).

facts.label: Food
facts.value: Smoked Desert Dumplings keep +20 Strength in Forever, and Grilled Squid now gives +1% crit instead of Agility. Icy Veins says both need an Iron Oven camp object (Cooking 300).

facts.label: Healing potions
facts.value: Made with First Aid instead of Alchemy in Forever.

facts.label: Furious Precision
facts.value: +4/7/10% hit with off-hand attacks (1 Oct notes).

facts.label: Hit cap at level 60
facts.note: No Blizzard figure, and community estimates for dual-wield swings conflict.

facts.label: Crit and Rage
facts.value: Basic-attack crits give 100% bonus Rage since 1 Oct (75% in the deep dive).

facts.label: Racials
facts.value: Human Ruthless +1% crit and Dwarf Artisan's Precision +1% hit with spells and attacks (26 Oct). No racial grants weapon skill.

facts.label: Flurry
facts.value: A critical strike grants 10%, 20% or 30% faster attacks for the next three swings, with no Death Wish prerequisite.

facts.label: Bloodthirst scaling
facts.value: 45% of Attack Power plus a flat amount since 1 Oct (35% in the deep dive), with no heal.

facts.label: Raid role
facts.value: Warcraft Tavern's PvE pick for Warriors: dual-wield damage with strong Cleave and Whirlwind cleave.

facts.label: Blizzard's class view
facts.value: Warriors are uniquely good at sustained damage against several melee targets and bring buffs and debuffs only they provide.

facts.label: Raging Blows
facts.value: Raging Blows, a Fury talent in the 16 Oct data, is not in the 10 Nov data.

facts.label: Death Wish
facts.value: Now raises all damage taken instead of lowering armor and resistances, so time it away from heavy raid damage.

facts.label: Battle Shout
facts.value: Raid-wide since 16 Oct, with the old Improved Battle Shout bonus built in.

facts.label: Onyxia's Lair entry
facts.value: Each raider needs their own Drakefire Amulet in their bags, and Blizzard tells raids to build fire resistance first.

facts.label: World buffs in raids
facts.value: Icy Veins' raid overview says world buffs are removed inside raids, and Wowhead's Forever data marks Rallying Cry of the Dragonslayer 'No effect while in a raid instance'.

facts.label: Flask rule
facts.value: One flask at a time, and it persists through death.

facts.label: Use a shield
facts.value: Blizzard lists an 80% threat bonus for Defensive Stance and 7%, 13% or 20% for Defiance. Defiance and Bastion retain their shield requirement.

facts.label: Threat tools
facts.value: Thunder Clap (Attack Power scaling, usable in Defensive Stance, 6-second cooldown), Sunder Armor (threat scales with Attack Power) and Demoralizing Shout (threat on every target hit).

facts.label: Rage from damage taken
facts.value: Uses the old formula but ignores armor (treated as a flat 50% reduction) and absorbs. An 8 Oct fix corrected the calculation.

facts.label: Anticipation
facts.value: Blizzard says it now gives double Defense per point.

facts.label: Improved Revenge
facts.value: Adds damage to Revenge instead of a stun.

facts.label: Raid tank
facts.value: Shield-based Protection is the intended raid tank. Warcraft Tavern notes that, unlike older Classic versions, Forever tanks should wear a shield.

facts.label: Long cooldowns
facts.value: Shield Wall and Retaliation are 15-minute cooldowns and no longer share a timer with Recklessness. Improved Shield Wall shortens Shield Wall further.

facts.label: Shield Wall (talentsforever data)
facts.value: 60% less damage taken for 12 seconds.
facts.note: Classic 1.12 Shield Wall was 75% for 10 seconds.

facts.label: Onyxia's Lair
facts.value: Every raider needs their own Drakefire Amulet. Blizzard warns of powerful fire attacks and repositioning across three phases, and tells raids to build fire resistance.

facts.label: Raid sizes
facts.value: Raid unlock date: 9 December 2026. Barrow Deeps (10), Hyjal Summit (20) and Onyxia's Lair (40) need tanks at all three sizes.

facts.label: Classic tank staples
facts.value: Flask of the Titans, Elixir of the Mongoose, Elixir of Greater Agility, Elixir of the Giants, Greater Stoneshield Potion and Limited Invulnerability Potion.

facts.label: Classic tank buffs and food
facts.value: Juju Might, Juju Power, Winterfall Firewater, Grilled Squid, Blessed Sunfruit and Smoked Desert Dumplings.

facts.label: Food in Forever
facts.value: Smoked Desert Dumplings (+20 Strength) and Dirge's Chops (+25 Stamina) keep their stats, while Grilled Squid now gives +1% crit. Icy Veins says these foods need an Iron Oven camp object (Cooking 300).
